case.title: mAbV
case.description: Identity, design system and brand kit for a new antibody company. A case study by Phil Parry.

slides.label: Context
slides.headline: A new company needed an identity to stand behind
body: mAbV develops antibodies that protect against infectious disease, with Oxford University. A young company that had said little in public yet, it came with a working name, a domain and a paragraph of science.
It needed an identity and a first web presence that investors and scientists could trust.

role.label: My role
role.text: Identity, design system, brand kit and holding page: design and build by me.

decode.note: Every letter is intentional. The casing makes the acronym readable inside the word.

slides.label: Design idea
slides.headline: A shield drawn from an antibody
body: An antibody is shaped like a Y, and this mark is built from one. The shield around it frames what the company works on.

quote.text: A premium scientific instrument — not a consumer brand.
quote.cite: The design philosophy, from the mAbV design system

art.alt: The full mAbV mark: a cobalt pointed shield with a V built from two antibody arms and a teardrop stem

items.text: Four bars: the antibody's two arms form the V
A teardrop stem forms the point

slides.label: Exploration
slides.headline: From the founder's sketch to a final mark
body: I developed the mark from the founder's first sketch into the final system: four bars and a teardrop stem, set in a pointed shield. On the way it was tested against ten other routes, at three sizes and on navy.

slides.label: Colour
slides.headline: One blue, specified for ink
body: Teal is the category's default, and the first draft's teal sat close to a familiar financial brand. I moved mAbV to one cobalt, tied it to Pantone 2728 C so print matches screen, and wrote the printer instruction into the kit.

slides.label: Two scripts
slides.headline: One mark, read in English and Chinese
body: In China the company trades as {{cn:百卫信}}. I set the characters in Noto Sans SC Bold, matched in weight to the DM Sans wordmark and licensed for commercial use, then outlined every lockup so it looks the same on any device.

slides.label: The system
slides.headline: A design system that shows its rules
body: Eight sections, live at mabvbio.com, from writing style and colour to logo and icon rules. The rules are shown, not just stated: below 32 px the full mark loses its detail, so it switches to a simple V. The ladder proves it.

shot.alt: The logo page of the live mAbV design system, with the full and simple marks

slides.label: Brand kit
slides.headline: Eighteen files, two languages, no guesswork
body: Four artworks in SVG, PNG, PDF and EPS, plus a social avatar. Type is outlined, so nothing falls back to a default font, and the readme comes in English and Chinese. One download from the design system.

shot.alt: Brand Kit page of the mAbV design system, with the download button and the brand essentials

quote.text: Please print the brand Cobalt as PANTONE 2728 C spot ink, not converted to CMYK.
